title: Petition of Camper Tours, Inc. pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7 and §§ 1-5 of the Appendix to G.L. c. 159A, requesting a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity, authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire for restricted sight-seeing purposes in the City of Boston from the Wrentham, Foxboro, Bellingham area.
